Badge Number: 6204
Subject: Female, approximately 25-30 years old, dressed in dark clothing with hooded sweatshirt
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows a person in dark clothing with a hood, but it is unclear if this is the subject described as a female in a hooded sweatshirt.

claims.claim_text: Deputy K. Padilla, Badge Number: 6204
Deputy L. Orozco
Deputy T. Yoon
Deputy J. Faulkner
Witness(es): None at scene

On June 24, 2020, at approximately 0115 hours, Orange County Communications Center received a 911 call from a cell phone reporting a residential burglary in progress at 22851 Loumont Drive, Lake Forest.
claims.evidence_observations: The title card states 'June 24, 2020 AT 0109 HOURS' and '22851 Loumont Drive, Lake Forest', matching the claim's details.

claims.claim_text: The caller reported hearing glass breaking and stated that an intruder had entered the home through a front window.
The caller was a female and that she and her boyfriend were sheltering inside the residence.
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states 'No, my boyfriend is here with me' and 'I'm hiding in the bathroom', indicating the caller and her boyfriend were inside.

claims.claim_text: Deputy Orozco was initially dispatched to the location.
Deputies Padilla, Yoon, and Faulkner also responded due to the nature of the call.
Dispatch informed us that the caller's line had gone dead and could not be reestablished.
I was the first unit to arrive at approximately 0105 hours.
I parked four houses west on Loumont Drive and proceeded on foot using my flashlight.
Within approximately thirty seconds of beginning my approach, I observed the subject standing under a tree on the sidewalk south of the residence, approximately 25 to 30 feet from my position.
claims.evidence_observations: The subject is visible standing under a tree on the sidewalk, approximately 25 to 30 feet from the camera's position.

claims.claim_text: The subject was wearing all black with the hood of her sweatshirt pulled over her head.
claims.evidence_observations: The subject is visible wearing dark clothing with the hood of her sweatshirt pulled over her head.

claims.claim_text: I illuminated the subject with my flashlight and observed that she was holding what appeared to be a black handgun at her side in her right hand, pointed toward the ground.
claims.evidence_observations: The subject is visible holding an object in her right hand that appears to be a black handgun pointed toward the ground.

claims.claim_text: I drew my service weapon and took a position of cover behind a gray sedan parked on the street.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows a person drawing their service weapon and taking a position of cover behind a gray sedan parked on the street.

claims.claim_text: I immediately began giving verbal commands, ordering the subject to show her hands, drop the weapon, and get on the ground.
claims.evidence_observations: The officer is issuing verbal commands, ordering the subject to show her hands, drop the weapon, and get on the ground.

claims.claim_text: The subject did not comply and appeared frozen in place.
claims.evidence_observations: The subject is visible standing still and not complying with the verbal commands.

claims.claim_text: Deputies Orozco and Yoon arrived approximately five minutes after my initial contact with the subject and took cover positions behind their vehicles.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows deputies arriving and taking cover positions behind their vehicles.

claims.claim_text: The three of us continued issuing verbal commands over the following several minutes.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows three officers continuing to issue verbal commands over several minutes.

claims.claim_text: The subject slowly began walking in my direction, holding the weapon at shoulder height with both hands.
claims.evidence_observations: The subject is visible slowly walking in the officer's direction, holding the weapon at shoulder height with both hands.

claims.claim_text: She then reversed course and walked back toward the tree.
claims.evidence_observations: The subject is visible reversing course and walking back toward the tree.

claims.claim_text: Deputy Faulkner arrived last and retrieved a rifle from his vehicle before joining our position.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows a person retrieving a rifle from their vehicle before joining the position.

claims.claim_text: At that point the subject had been standing under the tree for approximately ten minutes since my initial contact.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows a subject standing under the tree for approximately ten minutes since initial contact.

claims.claim_text: The subject then abruptly turned and pointed the handgun in the direction of the deputies.
claims.evidence_observations: The subject is visible abruptly turning and pointing the handgun in the direction of the deputies.

claims.claim_text: I discharged my firearm three times.
claims.evidence_observations: The officer is visible discharging his firearm three times.

claims.claim_text: Deputy Yoon discharged his firearm five times.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows a person discharging their firearm five times.

claims.claim_text: The subject immediately collapsed and the weapon dropped from her hands.
claims.evidence_observations: The subject is visible collapsing and the weapon dropping from her hands.

claims.claim_text: We approached the subject and secured the weapon.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows officers approaching the subject and securing the weapon.

claims.claim_text: Deputies began administering first aid.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows officers beginning to administer first aid.

claims.claim_text: Paramedics arrived at approximately 0125 hours, approximately ten minutes after the shooting.
The subject was transported by ambulance.
She was later pronounced deceased at the hospital.
Upon examination, the weapon was determined to be a Daisy 340 BB Spring Repeater Pistol, a realistic replica.
Investigation subsequently revealed the 911 call had been placed from the subject's own phone, and no burglary had occurred at the reported address.
Patrol vehicle video recordings from all responding units
Ten (10) cartridge casings recovered from the scene
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows ten (10) cartridge casings recovered from the scene.

claims.claim_text: One (1) Daisy 340 BB Spring Repeater Pistol, black
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows one (1) Daisy 340 BB Spring Repeater Pistol, black.
